replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Just a few things:
Good job in adding levels from my last comment. I remember your old map and this one is better. 
The border control is a little close to the defense and the lanes seem a little wide for this style of a map. 
Not really a gameplay thing but the iron is not lined up correctly and it is killing me
I can't comment on chests in the game because there are no items in my version. 
Back to my levels comment as I said this was better, it can improve. The levels seem a little put in. When I say that it just feels they are there to create levels. As a strategist I won't be using the levels because they are kind of useless. They are easy to break.
The middle seems a bit over powered. Have something in the sides or a reason to get to the sides if you are putting something in the middle.
It is very easy to defend this map. All you need to do is destroy the structures of the map. The only real thing to do is to skybridge. Skybridging is good but too much of it can make a map stale.
Last thing I can see right now is the spawns. They are a little close. I would suggest a respawn timer of some sorts so that people won't just repsawn and get to the skybridge as fast as they can. The stalemate would be huge and wouldn't be good for this type of CTW.
